We confirm that the account ACC-696251 is associated with the original creditor, Lakeshore Utilities. The current balance on this account is $4,924.62. We have verified that the charge-off date for this account is March 8, 2021, and the last payment date was June 16, 2021.

We will investigate your dispute and confirm the accuracy of the account information. As required by the FCRA, we will also provide you with a written validation of the debt, which will include the amount of the debt, the name of the creditor, and a statement that the debt is past due.

You have the right to further dispute this account if you believe the results of our investigation do not accurately reflect the account. Please note that you may also request a free copy of your credit report from the three major credit reporting agencies.
